take_homes: Access is not uptake. Count how much people actually use before quoting any percentage to the board.
Agent output needs sources I can check, and the agent's own summary of itself is not neutral.
Every plan needs a written condition for dropping it. The training gave no cost or payback figure at all.

monday.move: Ask my controller to try an agent on the month-end variance commentary once, with every claim in it tied to a source line, and compare it against the hand-written version.
monday.who: My controller, with me reviewing the output
monday.stop_condition: Any figure without a traceable source, or review time not clearly lower than writing it by hand
monday.blocker: IT has not approved the tool for finance data, so it runs on non-sensitive sample data until they do.

misconception.why: The line that the model improves for free but company knowledge only improves when someone writes it down and someone else picks it up. That makes it a capability to build, not a licence to buy. It's shaken, not changed: nobody gave me a figure for the cost of building it.

one_line: Two lines worth keeping, count what was actually used and say when you'd drop the plan, but 70 minutes with twenty agents and no cost figure anywhere.
